overlap.meaning: Co-displayed historical observation within the model calendar season. GODAS is monthly potential temperature; this instantaneous in-situ profile is not used for a direct model-observation residual.

qc_policy: Eligible samples require selected PRES/TEMP/PSAL QC 1 or 2, position/time QC 1 or 2, finite values and nonnegative pressure. No raw fallback in A/D mode.
depth_method: -gsw.z_from_p(selected pressure, profile latitude), GSW 3.6.20; dynamic height and sea-surface geopotential use library defaults (zero).

global.title: Argo float vertical profile

juld.normalization: Rounded to nearest second; original numeric days retained.

SCIENTIFIC_CALIB_EQUATION: PSAL_ADJUSTED includes correction for the effects of pressure adj + Cnd. Thermal Mass (CTM), Johnson et al. JAOT (2007) + dS computed from potential conductivity (ref to 0 dbar) multiplicative adjustment term r
SCIENTIFIC_CALIB_COEFFICIENT: CTM: alpha=0.141, tau=6.68s  with error equal to the correction. OWC: r = 1.0002 (+/-0), vertically averaged dS = 0.01 (+/-0).
SCIENTIFIC_CALIB_COMMENT: Pressure adjusted using reported surface pressure. The quoted error is manufacturer specified accuracy in dbar.
The quoted error is manufacturer specified accuracy with respect to ITS-90.

Significant salinity sensor drift detected. OW least squares fit adopted, mapping scales [lon:8/4, lat:4/2, no PV constr, decorr timescale:10 yrs]. PSAL_ADJ_ERR = max(0.01, OW + CTM + sensor accuracy).
